

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 7

#| 


channel_labels <- c(
                      "grindr" = "Grindr", 
                      "unknown" = "Unknown\nChannel", 
                      "partner_toolkit" = "Toolkit",
                      "instagram" = "Instagram", 
                      "twitter" = "Twitter"
                      )

plot <- targets::tar_read(participant_data)  %>%
    mutate(channel = factor(channel, names(channel_labels), channel_labels )) %>%
    group_by(channel) %>%
    summarize(count = n()) %>%
    filter(!is.na(channel)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(level = channel) %>%
    mutate(proportion = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot() + 
        ggplot2::geom_bar(aes(x = level, fill = level, y = proportion), width = 1, stat = "identity") + 
      ggplot2::geom_text(aes(x = level, y = proportion + 0.05, label = count), alpha = 0.7) +
          ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(
                                                dark_blue, 
                                                dark_pink, 
                                                dark_purple, 
                                                light_blue, 
                                                light_pink, 
                                                light_purple)
            ) + 
      ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous("Proportion of participants", labels = scales::percent) + 
    labs(
      title    = captions_and_titles("radarchannel")$title,
      subtitle = captions_and_titles("radarchannel")$subtitle,
      caption  = captions_and_titles("radarchannel")$caption %>% str_wrap(110) %>% paste0("\n\n", captions_and_titles("common_caption") )
    )

    
    apply_style_spacing_descriptives(plot)
```
